node.title: L1 background-overlap singleton payment
node.statement: Fix one source chart, defect degree d, and exact petal support of size h. Put N=k-1, a=N-d, s=h-d, and g=ell-b. Every compatible word has at least ell-s background agreements, so two words share at least ell-2s+g background points. Their degree-at-most-N difference already vanishes on the h petal points; hence the cell is a singleton whenever a+s<ell+g. At fixed petal polarity this whole region is polynomial per chart. Combining the strict complement with the sub-Johnson condition gives the exact survivor strip a^2/N<=c=N-h=a-s<=2a-ell-g. An exact F_17 ell=2 chart has two contributors at equality a+s=ell+g=3, so strictness is load-bearing.
